reason: Record hosted coverage shard producer and aggregation gate implementation.

operation.summary: Implemented hosted coverage workspace shard producers that collect run-scoped profraw profiles and a final hosted aggregation gate that renders the authoritative workspace summary before merging with runtime coverage.
changes: Added collect/report modes, shard selection, run-scoped profile roots, profraw import, and input validation to adl/tools/run_authoritative_coverage_lane.sh.
Fanned adl-coverage-workspace-hosted across four workspace profraw shard producers while keeping non-full PR-fast coverage on shard 1 only.
Moved authoritative full workspace summary rendering, lcov/text release artifact generation, provenance verification, and workspace/runtime summary merge into adl-coverage-hosted.
Updated coverage runner, CI runtime, and path-policy contracts to prove the new shard/aggregation topology and guard against stale workflow expectations.
